talk.title: How RBI is automating its cloud foundation with AWS Step Functions
talk.abstract: How can AWS Step Functions transform daily cloud operations? Join us to explore how RBI is using workflow orchestration to automate its cloud foundation. We’ll share practical insights from our Cloud Center of Excellence, demonstrating how Step Functions power landing zone operations, simplify automation, speed up deployments and enable scalable cloud governance across the organization.

speakers.name: Roman Jokel
speakers.bio: Roman Jokel is a Cloud Architect at Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) in Vienna, where he works on the bank's AWS cloud foundation, including automating landing zone operations with AWS Step Functions in RBI's Cloud Center of Excellence. He has presented RBI's cloud work at AWS Summit Zurich 2024 and AWS Summit Hamburg 2025, holds the AWS Solutions Architect - Professional, Advanced Networking - Specialty and Security - Specialty certifications, and is a co-organizer of the AWS User Group Vienna.

segments.title: Building Conversational Agents in Code with AWS Lambda Durable Functions

talk.title: Building Conversational Agents in Code with AWS Lambda Durable Functions
talk.abstract: Building agentic AI workflows typically requires Step Functions or complex database state machines to handle human delays. AWS Lambda Durable Functions change that. You write sequential code in a single Lambda function that can suspend for days and resume instantly, and you only pay for active compute time. In this session, we will orchestrate Amazon Bedrock conversational agents using the Sinch Conversation API to handle inbound interactions. You will learn how to dispatch AI specialists, use simple callbacks to wait for asynchronous human input, and replace heavy infrastructure boilerplate with native durable execution.
